Overview

The Snowdrift Stations A and B were added in the 1.71.0 Christmas Update on December 1st, 2024. It was added alongside a full map revamp of the Snowlands.

Usage

The cablecar is to bring cars to and from each station, aka across the biome. It is also an easy way to get to Gizmo's Observatory. In order to use it, you need either ~$2,500 or a Red Keycard. The cablecar takes about 33 seconds to go from one side to the other not including wait times.

Trivia

  • During the first few days of Version 1.71.0 being out, the Cablecar was bugged, meaning it would be nonfunctional, the Sleepy Bridgeman would steal your money, and the Cablecar itself would be on the ground.
